entities.name: Safe AI Fund
entities.focus: AI safety, responsible AI development, technical guardrails

enhancedPersonalization.tailoredHook: You built this fund because capability without constraint is not progress. We exist for the same reason: to make governance infrastructure that keeps pace with what AI can do.
painPoints: Fragmented safety standards across jurisdictions create compliance chaos for portfolio companies
No independent body exists to validate safety claims without conflicts of interest
Technical teams lack clear guidance on governance implementation at scale
Investors cannot verify AI risk exposure without standardized accountability frameworks
enhancedPersonalization.valueProposition: Alygn provides the independent governance infrastructure your portfolio needs: verifiable accountability mechanisms, cross-border coordination protocols, and technical standards that satisfy both regulators and engineers.
enhancedPersonalization.personalizedPS: P.S.: Your thesis assumes safety and speed are not tradeoffs. We agree. The question is who builds the guardrails before they become gates.

entities.name: Halcyon Futures
entities.focus: Long-term futures, transformative technology, civilization-scale impact

enhancedPersonalization.tailoredHook: Halcyon invests in futures worth inhabiting. We build the governance infrastructure those futures require. The gap between technical possibility and institutional readiness is where both of us operate.
painPoints: Long-term AI risk lacks institutional memory or coordination mechanisms
Portfolio companies face emerging regulatory landscapes without precedents
Civilizational-scale technologies demand governance that outlives funding cycles
No durable framework exists for multi-stakeholder AI accountability across decades
enhancedPersonalization.valueProposition: Alygn offers institutional permanence for the technologies Halcyon backs: governance frameworks designed for generational time horizons, not quarterly reports.
enhancedPersonalization.personalizedPS: P.S.: The future does not govern itself. Someone must build the scaffolding while the concrete is still wet.

enhancedPersonalization.tailoredHook: Evolution Equity understands that security and governance are the same problem viewed from different angles. As AI systems become critical infrastructure, the attack surface expands. So does the governance surface.
painPoints: AI systems introduce unquantified security risks that traditional cybersecurity cannot address
European regulatory complexity (AI Act, GDPR, NIS2) creates compliance fragmentation
Portfolio companies lack frameworks for AI incident response and accountability
Cross-border AI operations face conflicting governance requirements without coordination mechanisms
enhancedPersonalization.valueProposition: Alygn bridges the gap between cybersecurity and AI governance: unified accountability frameworks that satisfy European regulators while enabling technical innovation.
enhancedPersonalization.personalizedPS: P.S.: You have seen how security failures cascade. Governance failures cascade slower but cut deeper.

entities.name: Glasswing Ventures
entities.focus: AI-native companies, intelligent automation, enterprise AI

enhancedPersonalization.tailoredHook: Glasswing invests in AI-native companies because you recognize intelligence as infrastructure. We exist because infrastructure without accountability becomes fragility.
painPoints: AI-native portfolio companies face existential regulatory risk as frameworks crystallize
Enterprise customers demand governance proof points that startups cannot yet provide
Technical founders understand models but lack institutional design expertise
Competition for AI talent distracts from building durable accountability systems
enhancedPersonalization.valueProposition: Alygn gives Glasswing portfolio companies a governance advantage: independent validation, coordinated standards, and institutional credibility that accelerates enterprise adoption.
enhancedPersonalization.personalizedPS: P.S.: The best AI companies will be those that build accountability in, not bolt it on.
